hard_class_invariants.description: HMAC-SHA-256 chain on rollback ledger; broken chain halts all ops
Rollback ledger is append-only; no record mutation permitted
No wall-clock injection; all timestamps via _utc_iso()
Rollback only on CRITICAL CSC alert or HUMAN-0 explicit token
Manual rollback requires HUMAN-0 ratification token
No amendment may be rolled back twice
Rollback state is ledger-backed and survives restarts
Each rollback record sealed with HMAC before ledger append
